committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 21 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid spend eased to A$123.39 across 19 clicks this week from A$153.44 and 26 clicks last week, nudging CPC up to A$6.49. The landing-page test sits at 48 raw paid clicks against the A$600 credit, with A$248.07 remaining.

No external Google Ads changes in the last 24h or 7d (status ok), so test numbers are not contaminated by outside edits. Search Console only runs through 18 Oct, two days behind yesterday (Tue 20), so organic figures lag. Rank lost to Ad Rank (73.5%) still exceeds budget lost (20.7%), worth watching though budget stays fixed until the test concludes.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 2 this week from 0, all via chatgpt.com, the first visible sign of the answer-engine work, though this almost certainly undercounts true AI referrals landing in Direct. Direct itself jumped to 26 sessions from 3, which is not evidence of unpaid demand. Organic Search held flat at 12 sessions, still the only trustworthy unpaid signal.

The dedicated landing page has logged 48 raw paid clicks and 10 ask_cta_click (question-form) events since the test began 6 Oct, with zero review bookings so far. Past click 25 the page is now frozen (headline, offer and CTAs locked) unless something breaks.

actions.text: Landing-page test has passed 25 raw paid clicks (48 total), so the page stays frozen: no changes to headline, offer or CTAs unless something is broken.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
